title: Unique Dark Expansion
description: An expansion to unique dark by Amongstreality to add compatibility with a few more mods (list is growing)
body:
**[Click to report mods that don't work](https://uniquedarkexpansion.featurebase.app)** This is an expansion to the absolute masterpiece of a resource pack: [Unique Dark](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unique-dark) by Amongstreality to support some more mods and missed things.
This pack currently supports
- GTCEU
- Collosal Chests
- AE2 dark mode/blackout (put this ABOVE everything else, including unique dark)
- AE2 wireless terminals
- Create's jei textures  
  (Some textures may not be fully implemented, please report those)
